title: A Framework for Egocentric and Exocentric Procedural Understanding via Temporal Segmentation and Semantic Abstraction
abstract: arXiv:2610.00069v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-horizon ego/exo data contains rich procedural evidence, but are redundant, noisy, and costly to process or retain. We propose a compact framework that converts continuous multimodal workplace video into a structured Procedural State Memory, implemented as a Work Environment Model (WEM). Inspired by event segmentation theory, we detect boundaries using changes in visual context, location, motion, narration, gaze/object interaction, and optional exocentric workspace evidence, rather than fixed windows or visual novelty alone. Each segment is abstracted into an evidence-linked event card containing actor, interval, location, action, objects/tools, pre/post state, confidence, and provenance. These event cards incrementally update the WEM, enabling compact, auditable documentation and retrieval under on-premise privacy constraints. We instantiate the design with frozen DINOv2 and VJEPA-2 encoders and a local language model, and outline

translated_title: 一种通过时间分割与语义抽象实现第一人称与第三人称程序性理解的框架
translated_abstract: 长时程的第一人称/第三人称数据包含丰富的程序性证据，但这些数据冗余、噪声大，且处理与保存成本高昂。我们提出了一个紧凑的框架，将连续的多模态工作场所视频转换为结构化的程序状态记忆，实现为工作环境模型（WEM）。受事件分割理论的启发，我们利用视觉情境、位置、运动、叙述、注视/物体交互以及可选的第三人称工作空间证据的变化来检测事件边界，而非仅依赖固定时间窗口或视觉新颖性。每个片段被抽象为一张证据关联的事件卡片，其中包含执行者、时间区间、位置、动作、物体/工具、前后状态、置信度和来源信息。这些事件卡片增量式地更新工作环境模型，从而在本地部署的隐私约束下实现紧凑、可审计的文档化与检索。我们使用冻结的DINOv2和VJEPA-2编码器以及本地语言模型来实例化该设计，并概述……
tldr: 该论文提出了一个将连续多模态工作场所视频转换为结构化“工作环境模型”的紧凑框架，通过受事件分割理论启发的多线索边界检测与证据关联的事件卡片抽象，实现了本地隐私约束下紧凑、可审计的程序性理解与检索。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a compact framework that converts continuous multimodal workplace video into a structured Work Environment Model (WEM) via event-segmentation-theory-inspired multi-cue boundary detection and evidence-linked event cards, enabling compact, auditable procedural understanding and retrieval under on-premise privacy constraints.
